title.narrative: Second Decentralized Public Service and Financial Management Sector Development Program, Subprogram 2

description.narrative: Subprogram 2 completes a series of Asian Development Bank (ADB) support for strengthening the role and capacity of subnational administrations (SNAs) to effectively deliver public services to the Cambodian population.2 This final subprogram is part of the approved sector development program (SDP) and programmatic approach that support (i) strengthened subnational planning and budgeting, (ii) improved revenue and expenditure management, and (iii) professionalized subnational staff to deliver improved services, to strengthen SNAs and improve citizens' access to public services, which in turn boosts equitable and inclusive local development. 3 Subprogram 2 contributes to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly (i) SDG 1 on ending poverty in all its forms everywhere; (ii) SDG 5 on achieving gender equality and empowering all women and girls; (iii) SDG 10 on reducing income inequality within and among countries; (iv) SDG 13 on taking urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts; and (v) SDG 16 on promoting peaceful and inclusive societies for sustainable development; providing access to justice for all; and building effective, accountable, and inclusive institutions at all levels.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

1.1. To improve alignment of subnational programs with national-level priorities, the MEF approved the subnational budget reform strategy (2019-2025) to integrate national and subnational planning processes and introduce program budgeting at the subnational level. (MEF)

1.2. To improve development planning and coordination at the subnational level, the government approved a sub-decree integrating sector line ministry staff at the district level into the structure of the district administrations. (NCDDS)

1.3. To strengthen risk management, controls and governance processes at the district/municipal level, the government established an internal control function to undertake financial audit, assess risk and conduct technical inspections. (NCDDS)

1.4. To strengthen service delivery at the district and provincial level, the government approved a sub-decree to establish one-window service units and offices to provide core administrative services (MOI).

1.5. To provide a sound platform for dispute resolution at the subnational level, the MOI established ombudsman offices in the capital and provinces and approved guidelines for fully functioning ombudsman offices with gender-sensitive training completed in at least 50% of ombudsmen offices at the capital and provincial level (MOI).

2.1. The government implemented the budget strategic plan and program budgeting in the capital and 24 provinces to strengthen the planning and budgeting framework for SNAs and better align subnational program priorities with national program priorities, including alignment with the Rectangular Strategy IV, Subnational Budget Reform Strategy 2019-2025, and National Development Plan, to meet local priorities for service delivery, reducing poverty, meeting infrastructure needs, and promoting gender equality. (MEF)

2.2. The government integrated planning functions at the subnational level, ensuring that the new structures are fully financed and staffed with a consolidated budget and a clearly defined management structure, under the leadership of the district and/or municipal governor for the unified DMK administration structures. (NCDDS)

2.3. The government implemented FMIS in 25 capital and province administrations and selected DMKs and communes and sangkats (urban communes)b to track and report local government spending to deepen decentralization of budget execution to the local level. (MEF)

2.4. The government (i) implemented one-window service offices and units in the capital and all provinces and DMKs to improve service delivery and (ii) designed and implemented digital tools (an online mobile application) for improved citizen knowledge, access, and transparency of services available at the subnational level. (MOI)

2.5. The government operationalized ombudsman offices in the capital, provinces, and DMKs, staffed with well-qualified and trained ombudsman staff to (i) monitor the quality of services provided to citizens; (ii) deliver effective dispute resolution services (including gender-sensitive mediation); and (iii) support digital tools for online access to investigation, complaints, and dispute resolution. (MOI)

Action 1: For improved responsiveness to local needs at the commune level, the MEF approved a 100% increase to the local development budget at commune and sangkat level (MEF). Target date: 2020-08-31

title.narrative: Policy 2 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Sep 01, 2020 - Apr 30, 2023

description.narrative:
Policy 2: Revenue and expenditure management to meet local needs improved Outcome 1: Service delivery by SNAs strengthened
Action 2: The National Assembly enacted the law on public property management to strengthen legal and policy basis for public property management at the subnational level to clearly define roles and responsibilities of the state property management authority, and the government issued (i) implementing regulations, and (ii) implemented the State Asset Registration Management Information System to comprehensively track and manage all assets at the local level. (MEF) Target date: 2023-04-30
Action 3: The government transferred 100% of revenues collected from fisheries concessions to SNAs; and approved regulations to transfer 50% of revenues collected from royalties from excavation and energy sources to SNAs, to strengthen revenue management and ensure clearly defined resource envelope for SNAs. (MEF) Target date: 2023-04-30
Action 1: To strengthen accountability in public administration, government approved a sub-decree and issued guidelines for subnational government to undertake personnel management independently including recruitment, and appointment and termination of civil servants. This led to the delegation of staff management from the center to subnational tiers (NCDDS/MOI). Target date: 2020-08-31

title.narrative: Policy 2 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Jan 01, 2017 - Aug 31, 2020

description.narrative:
Policy 2: Revenue and expenditure management to meet local needs improved Outcome 1: Service delivery by SNAs strengthened
Action 2: To improve management of subnational assets, the MEF submitted the law on management, utilization, and arrangement of state property for approval to the Council of Ministers in consultation with relevant key stakeholders for the transparent, predictable and fair management of state property. (MEF) Target date: 2020-08-31
Action 3: To strengthen nontax revenue base at the subnational level, the prime minister approved, and the government endorsed a transfer of 15% share of non-tax revenues collected by line ministries to SNAs. (MEF) Target date: 2020-08-31
Action 1: The government (i) approved a dedicated financial management role at all communes and sangkats to improve revenue and expenditure tracking, and (ii) issued guidance for effective financial management for communes and sangkats to better manage resources and meet infrastructure and social development priorities. (MEF, MOI and NCDDS) Target date: 2023-04-30

title.narrative: Policy 3 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Sep 01, 2020 - Apr 30, 2023

description.narrative:
Policy 3: Public administration skills and competencies of subnational officials enhanced Outcome 1: Service delivery by SNAs strengthened
Action 2: The government, following the approval of a sub-decree (i) operationalized NASLA as a separate budget entity for effective management and accountability for its sustainable operations, and (ii) included MOWA in the NASLA Board to operationalize NASLA in line with gender considerations. (NASLA and MOI) Target date: 2023-04-30
Action 3: NASLA designed and delivered new courses on an annual basis, for strengthened local development planning: (i) innovation for local administrations; (ii) leadership training programs at subnational level and women leadership; and (iii) localizing sustainable development goals at the subnational level, and integrated gender-sensitive curricula principles. (NASLA and MOI) Target date: 2023-04-30
Action 4: The government commenced the implementation of its gender equality, social equity, and inclusiveness strategy (2021-2030) to enable SNAs to deliver local development objectives without discrimination based on gender, religions, sex, disability, ethnicity, and boost participation in public service and local development. (MOI) Target date: 2023-04-30

title.narrative: Policy 3 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Jan 01, 2017 - Aug 31, 2020

description.narrative:
Policy 3: Public administration skills and competencies of subnational officials enhanced Outcome 1: Service delivery by SNAs strengthened
Action 2: To strengthen capacity at the subnational level, the MOI endorsed the prakasi on capacity development and the five-year Strategic Plan of Capacity Development of MOI and SNA personnel to establish longer-term capacity development plan for SNA staff. (MOI) Target date: 2020-08-31
Action 3: NASLA delivered at least five pilot training courses including at least one course on women's leadership, as part of the MOI Interim Training Strategy (2019-2023) (MOI). Target date: 2020-08-31
Action 4: To promote gender equality at the subnational level, NCDDS approved a subnational gender equality policy in consultations with key government and nongovernment stakeholders to boost women's representation in decision-making roles in local government and address their needs in public services (NCDDS). Target date: 2020-08-31
Action 1: The government (i) approved the principles, modalities, and procedures of capital administration, provincial administration, and district and municipal administration to implement the legal framework for subnational personnel management; and (ii) issued regulations to establish clearly defined responsibilities and performance standards for subnational staff according to their grade and ranking. (NCDDS/MOI) Target date: 2023-04-30
